findings.finding: One-time callback nonces were retained indefinitely.
findings.correction: Store nonce expiry and purge expired replay entries during verification.

unresolved_exceptions.detail: Telegram health is an on-demand getMe probe; persistent polling/webhook hosting is a later deployment concern.

revisit_trigger: Telegram transport hosting, callback payload, role, or command changes.

findings.finding: Approval and deployment commands required explicit role boundaries and transport-only behavior.
findings.correction: Enforce owner/operator/reviewer/viewer command sets and make deployment non-executing until its policy phase.

revisit_trigger: New Telegram action, role, callback, or sensitive formatter.

findings.finding: Updates, callbacks, users, and chats required separate replay/backpressure controls.
findings.correction: Add bounded update deduplication, one-use callbacks, and independent sliding windows for users and chats.

revisit_trigger: Concurrent update dispatch or multi-instance bot deployment.

findings.finding: Telegram business orchestration would duplicate HTTP behavior.
findings.correction: Keep the adapter transport-focused and reuse TaskApplicationService.

findings.finding: No behavioral tests existed for commands, roles, callback tamper/expiry/replay, FloodWait, chunking, redaction, or transport failure.
findings.correction: Add command and failure-boundary tests plus shared-service integration.
